### How to Show Faith and Gratitude in Your Battle
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-march-15-2020.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:21
Points:
- When facing overwhelming battles, believers should choose praise and worship rather than anxiety.
- King Jehoshaphat sent an unarmed choir to the front lines to thank God before the fighting started.
- Thanking God after deliverance shows gratitude, but thanking Him in advance demonstrates faith.
- When the people began praising God, the Lord intervened and caused the enemy forces to destroy themselves.
- Believers must lay down self-reliant weapons and trust God to fight on their behalf.

### Power in Worship
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-with-greg-laurie-apr-20-2006-1391520.html
Passage: 2 Chronicles 20:21
Points:
- Genuine worship carries supernatural power capable of breaking enemy strongholds.
- Praising God transforms spiritual atmospheres, just as David's worship brought relief to tormented King Saul.
- Facing insurmountable odds, Jehoshaphat directed singers to lead the troops with songs of God's enduring mercy.
- As the people worshiped, God confounded the opposing armies so that they turned on each other.
- Approaching life's battles with praise prepares the way for God to display His power and deliverance.
